New Age Rehabilitation Centre Pvt Ltd is one of the Leading Chain of Physiotherapy Clinics in North India. We have a Team of Physiotherapists Qualified and Experienced in all Specialities of Medicine like Orthopedics, Sports Injuries, Neurology & Neuro-surgery,  Cardiorespiratory etc. We are using Advanced technology Physiotherapy Equipment from World's leading Companies for ensuring Safety of the Patient.

New Age Rehab has a strong presence in Delhi, Faridabad, Rohtak and Raipur through Physiotherapy Clinics, Physiotherapy Department in leading Hospitals, Residential Rehabilitation Centers and Homecare services.
